prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: vertical social-media artwork for the “Your Dark Side” theme

Create an original dystopian dark-surrealist image in a vast circular chamber beneath a dead city. At the center, an androgynous figure in a simple bone-white garment holds a small radiant sphere close to their chest, like the last living sun. Their ribcage is not exposed or injured; instead, an elegant external cage of thin black metallic branches grows around their torso and slowly closes around the light. Behind the person, thousands of suspended empty cages disappear upward into darkness. The person’s calm posture contrasts with the feeling that they are imprisoning their own light.

Vertical 9:16 framing, full-body subject in the lower-middle of the composition, enormous negative space above, concentric brutalist architecture, cinematic scale, subtle fog. The small sphere provides warm ivory illumination on the figure; everything beyond it falls into cold charcoal and silver shadow. A single hairline of dark crimson circles the floor like a warning. Photorealistic materials, restrained surrealism, editorial sci-fi still, crisp silhouette and intense emotional clarity.

Color palette: deep charcoal, obsidian, bone white, cold silver, faint ivory light, minimal dark crimson.

Constraints: original visual metaphor; no exposed anatomy, no injury, no recognizable person, no text, logos, signatures, borders, or watermark.

Avoid: portrait close-up, split identity face, black goo, red eyes, gore, conventional angel or demon imagery, flames, decorative fantasy styling, imitation of any named artist.

promptZh:
使用场景：风格化概念艺术
资产类型：适用于“你的阴暗面”主题的竖屏社交媒体艺术作品

创作一张原创的反乌托邦暗黑超现实主义图像，场景设定在“死寂城市下方巨大的圆形密室”中。在中心位置，一个穿着“简约骨白色服装”的中性人物将一个微小的发光球体紧贴胸前，宛如最后的生命之阳。他们的胸腔并未裸露或受伤，取而代之的是，一个由纤细黑色金属枝条构成的优雅外骨架在躯干周围生长，并缓慢地向光芒合拢。在人物身后，成千上万个悬挂的空鸟笼向上方没入黑暗之中。人物平静的姿态与他们正在囚禁自身光芒的压抑感形成鲜明对比。

9:16 竖构图，主体位于画面中下部，上方留出巨大的负空间，同心圆式的野兽派建筑，电影级尺度，淡淡的薄雾。小球为人物提供温暖的象牙色照明；除此之外的一切都沉浸在冰冷的炭灰与银色阴影中。一抹细如发丝的深绯红色圆环绕着地面，如同警示。写实材质，克制的超现实主义，编辑级科幻剧照，清晰的轮廓与强烈的视觉情感表达。

配色方案：深炭灰、黑曜石色、骨白色、冷银色、微弱的象牙色光芒、极简的深绯红色。

约束条件：原创视觉隐喻；无裸露解剖结构，无伤口，无具体可辨认的人物，无文字、Logo、签名、边框或水印。

避免：肖像特写、分裂的身份面孔、黑色粘液、红眼、血腥、传统的各种天使或恶魔形象、火焰、装饰性奇幻风格、模仿任何特定艺术家。
